The letter's body is written as ordinary prose. Everything above the first
paragraph — the recipient, the date, the title and the opening — is drawn from
the YAML header, as is the closing that follows the last paragraph.

I write to apply for the chair of General Physics. Having isolated polonium and
radium at the EPCI, and directed the laboratory's work on radioactivity since
1897, I would be glad to continue that work within the Faculty.

# A heading becomes a letter section

Headings are set as letter sections, which sit in running text rather than
opening a page the way the CV's sections do. Lists, emphasis and links all work
as they do anywhere else in Quarto:

- Isolated polonium and radium
- Two Nobel Prizes, in Physics and in Chemistry
